evidence.snippet: To evaluate Code2LoRA against parameter-efficient fine-tuning baselines, we build RepoPeftBench, a benchmark of 604 Python repositories with two tracks: a static track with 40K training and 12K test assertion-completion tasks, and an evolution track with 215K commit-derived training and 87K commit-derived test tasks.

claire_radar.motivation: Code language models need repository-level context to resolve imports, APIs, and project conventions.
